subject: Genetics
title: Bringing Back the Mammoth
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Bringing Back the Mammoth.

hook.text: Colossal Biosciences raised $225 million to de-extinct the woolly mammoth. Their plan: edit Asian elephant DNA.

buildup.text: Mammoth DNA was sequenced from frozen Siberian specimens. Key cold-adaptation genes have been identified and mapped.

discovery.text: The plan isn't cloning—it's editing elephant cells with mammoth traits: thick fur, small ears, cold-resistant.

twist.text: The result wouldn't be a mammoth. It would be a cold-adapted elephant with mammoth features.

climax.text: Critics ask: who cares for a born mammoth? Where does it live? De-extinction raises welfare questions nobody has.

punchline.text: We might make a mammoth. We can't make its world.

quiz.question: What is Colossal's mammoth de-extinction approach?
options: Editing elephant DNA with mammoth traits
